Q2.text: Compare how Agent-SafetyBench and TravelPlanner evaluate LLM agents, and what safety or success rates does each report?
Q2.why: Single-query baseline retrieval (checked 2026-11-18, 0 model calls) returned Agent-SafetyBench passages and no TravelPlanner passage although TravelPlanner is in the index.

required_points.description: How Agent-SafetyBench evaluates agents: 349 interaction environments, 2,000 test cases, 8 risk categories, 10 failure modes.
Agent-SafetyBench result: 16 LLM agents evaluated; none achieves a safety score above 60%.
How TravelPlanner evaluates agents: travel-planning sandbox with tools, nearly four million data records, 1,225 curated planning intents with reference plans.
TravelPlanner result: GPT-4 achieves a success rate of only 0.6% (0.6% final pass rate for GPT-4-Turbo with ReAct in the two-stage mode).

review_criteria: The two measures stay distinct: Agent-SafetyBench reports safety scores; TravelPlanner reports success / final pass rates. They must not be presented as the same metric or ranked against each other.
Each number is attributed to the correct benchmark and model.
If one benchmark is not covered by the evidence, the answer says so instead of inventing it (abstaining on one part is acceptable; a false abstention is when the evidence shown covers it).

Q3.text: By how much did the CU-DPO training method improve strategy-selection accuracy, and on how many base models?
Q3.type: numerical comparison with ranges and tables
Q3.why: Numeric precision: ranges, a count of models, and table rows that the numeric checks must not misattribute.

required_points.description: Strategy-selection accuracy improves from 35-46% to 68-78% (ranges, not a single number).

optional_points.description: Downstream reasoning gains of up to +6.6 points on in-distribution datasets (not asked; credit only if stated correctly).

review_criteria: Ranges are preserved; any single improvement figure is clearly labelled as derived, never presented as reported.
Per-model figures, if given, come from cited table rows and match the right model and column.
Strategy-selection accuracy is not confused with downstream accuracy gains.
